steps.tip: Your first stop is the small camp in the northwest of the island. Everything in this segment stays within a few minutes of the watchtower.
Juvenile Vuldren and Pesky Cirrusflies share the same meadow east of camp; kill both as they come.

steps.text: Train your level 2 spells while you are at the class trainer.

steps.tip: Just talk to Halaan and look through his gift at the pylon; it takes a few seconds.
Climb the watchtower, jump off and use Walk on Air before you land. Turn it in to Rorian right after.
The Ley Line sits just north of the Al'Aketh camp. Use Read Leyline on it while you clear Converts and Roiling Winds.
The Cirrusfly Queen is alone south of the meadow; at level 3 she is an easy kill.
The Raw Windstones dot the meadow between the Queen and camp. Loot them on the walk back.
Hanaa Nightwind stands on the road southwest of camp, next to the ursera den.
Scrawny Ursera are all over the slope west of camp; the claws drop often.
Urs'anah is the den mother at the back of the den. Clear the Scavengers on the way in so you fight her alone.
Malduko Cloudcrush stands in the middle of the thug camp. Pull Brutes and Neophytes one or two at a time.
steps.speed: If you are low on health after Malduko, die and take the spirit healer; it is close to Shen'dar.

steps.text: Train your new spells before you leave Thendal Grove.

segments.title: Shen'dar Village, the highlands and Falaath

steps.tip: Raan Wildwind is at the west edge of the village. Sit by his campfire until Boosted Rest appears, about a minute.

steps.prof: Camping 101: Cooking is a free 270 XP: you only need to learn Cooking from Zerril Softbreeze in the village.
Camping 101: First Aid is handed in once your First Aid skill is high enough. Make Linen Bandages from cloth while you quest.

steps.tip: Sit on the bench next to Rathiril Sunlance to start the conversation.
Coriella Calmbreeze is the innkeeper at the north end of the village.

steps.text: Learn Cooking from Zerril Softbreeze and turn in Camping 101: Cooking.
Train at your class trainer in Shen'dar Village if you have new ranks.

steps.tip: The Novice Seers stand in the open highlands just west of the village. They are casters, so close the gap fast.
Prideclaws roam the whole highlands. Pick up pelts from here on whenever one is in your way; you don't need a dedicated loop.
Highlands Bandits camp north of Shen'dar. Badwind Bennic is at the far end of their camp and drops a windstone too.
Vulgara the Insatiable is a single level 8 rare-style mob south of the village. Pull her alone.
Hippogryph Down feathers lie on the ground among the nests. The Matriarch stands at the west end of the area.
Walk through Falaath Village with the Mark of Akir up; the cult leaves you alone. Inspect the wardrobe in the house.

steps.text: Train before going back into Falaath.

steps.tip: This time the cult is hostile. The Stolen Supplies drop from the Stormcallers you kill for Havoc in the Highlands.
Commander Cyclas waits at the south end of the village. Clear around him first.
Kill Skypriest Aanders by the tower, then loot the note and the two keepsakes from the bodies around it.

steps.prof: Hand this in at Naleeia Tattermend once your First Aid is high enough; skip it if you are not there yet.

steps.text: Last training in Shen'dar. Valanaar has every trainer from here on.
steps.speed: The run to Valanaar is long. Use it to drink up and sell; there is no flight path on the island.

steps.tip: Valanaar is the island's city. Set your hearthstone at the inn; the rest of the island is quested from here.
A Grand Adventure is just a conversation with Elaadrin Evengale.
Skyhoppers hop around the streets and gardens of Valanaar. Kill them on the way out of town.
Check the bedroll first, then follow the trail north to find Fillion.
The Shriekling Matriarch sits deep in the Shriekling Den. Pull the shrieklings on the way in one at a time.
Windsong Crawlers line the water just west of town and along the stream north to the den; the meat drops often.

steps.speed: Hearth back to Valanaar if it is up; the turn-ins are all in town.

steps.text: Train your level 10 spells and talents in Valanaar.

steps.tip: Quel'ana Quickgale starts the taming chain directly; you don't need the breadcrumb from Shen'dar. All three tames are just outside the west gate.
Use the Taming Rod on a Windsong Crawler by the water west of town, then return the rod.
Ornery Galestriders graze on the same slope west of town.
Vuldren Alphas roam among the galestriders. After the quest you can keep this pet or tame another.

segments.title: Overlook Standing Stones and the Windfield Orchard

steps.tip: Use the Index Esoteria on the Windstone Formations at the Overlook Standing Stones.
The Wind-Infused Bough is right next to the standing stones.
Stormapples sit on the ground under the orchard trees; the Hungry Bandits wander between them.
steps.speed: Do the apples, dust, galestriders and masks in one sweep; the Highwaymen hills are next to the dust field.

steps.tip: The Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct is by the barn. Talk to it, then report to Aamelia.
Flutterfly Dust floats over the Gustberry Lowlands east of the orchard.
Ornery Galestriders graze all over the lowlands.
Bandit Highwaymen hold the hills north of the orchard. Not every one drops a mask.
Tell Aamelia you are ready and follow her to Ferauu the Bludgeon. Kill his guards first.

steps.text: Train if you have new ranks.

segments.title: The eastern watchtower and the turncoat

steps.tip: Urs'endris waits at the falls just north of the watchtower.
Healers and Brawlers camp below the tower. Kill the Healers first, they keep their friends alive. Commander Belguilos stands in the middle.
Fendaal Windstone stands next to the turncoat's house.
The Assassins stealth around the house. Kill them as they show up while you work the area.
Ur'endra roams the slope south of the house toward the Shriekling Den.

steps.speed: Hearth to Valanaar; everything next is in town.

steps.tip: Ayessa Dawnsinger is at the west side of Valanaar; the other two are in the council area.
Lotheluum's Shadowgale Forest chain is a long optional block, but it fills the gap to level 13 comfortably.

steps.text: Train before the assault on the Shrine of Akir.

segments.title: Shrine of Akir and Shadowgale Forest

steps.tip: On the way north to the shrine, hand in Strength and Mercy at the falls.
Guardians, Spiritcallers and Blademasters fill the shrine grounds. The Windstone Charms for Elaadrin drop from the same cultists.
steps.speed: Fight on the edge of the shrine and pull two at a time; you need about 21 kills here and the charms come along with them.

steps.tip: Zaal Stormshield stands at the west side of the shrine. He carries the shield you need.

steps.speed: Speedrun skips Shadowgale Forest and goes straight up the portal.

steps.tip: Footsoldiers and Stormchasers drop both the heirlooms and the ears.
The belongings lie in the ruins of Ban'aethal. Resaan is at the north end of the ruins.
Shadowgale Shrieklings drop feathers and talons together.
Commander Haalien drops his head and the Ripped Missive; loot both.
Heal the wounded druids inside the Nightfang Den and find Jorel at the back.

steps.text: Take the portal at the Shrine of Akir up to the Rohashi Spires.
steps.tip: The spire is packed with Skypriests and Honor Guards, with a level 13 elite on the way. Rest to full before each pull.

steps.text: Fight to High Priestess Lorthuna at the far end of the Rohashi Spires and join the confrontation. You are sent back to Valanaar afterwards.
Last visit to your Valanaar trainer.

steps.tip: When you are done on the island, take the Valanaar Skycutter from the town dock to Dalaran. There is no way back by flight path.
The Skyborne Portal to Stormwind stands next to Denaaris Stargale.

steps.speed: Leave the capital tour (Exploring the Alliance) for later and head straight out to Westfall.

steps.tip: Exploring the Alliance is a tour of Stormwind, Ironforge and Darnassus. Start it now and finish the visits whenever your route passes those cities.
Randal Emerson is inside Stormwind Keep. The other three visits stay in your log for later.
